notes.title: ROTT launcher update from 10/11/2014
notes.notes:
On starting the launcher for the second time after applying the update, the game will run immediately if nothing has been changed in your subscribed items from the Workshop. Starting the launcher for the first time will take some time, as it needs to collect some data about your subscriptions.

Also fixed a bug regarding a lot of sound files in temporary directories - it was extracting some files to random directories for no reason. This shouldn't happen anymore.

Enjoy the new patch!

notes.title: HOTFIX INCOMING - PLEASE UPDATE ROTT
notes.notes: Hey guys - we're pushing a hotfix live that should fix any server connection issues! Once we've confirmed it's tested - modders can recook maps and we'll get this Free weekend into high gear and start the sale! WOOOOOOOOOOOO ːAnkhː

notes.title: Rise of the Triad 1.4 patch adds Doomstick and six new multiplayer maps
notes.notes: Rise of the Triad is getting a fresh shotgun for your face with its latest patch. Update 1.4 will introduce the new Doomstick shotgun, along with six new multiplayer maps.

notes.title: Rise of the Triad 1.1 patch adds five new multiplayer maps
notes.notes: Rise of the Triad has released its first patch, clearing out a laundry list of bugs, all based on player feedback. Update 1.1 also brings performance optimizations and five free extra multiplayer maps.

notes.title: Ludicrous Development Kit Livestream! (Is now OVER! Confirmed changes/additions posted!)
notes.notes:
Did you miss the Rise of the Triad ludicrous livestream? 

Watch the replay! http://youtu.be/sBAemhdU0uM
We confirmed FIVE new multiplayer maps, custom map playlists, new modes (Horde mode?!), the Ludicrous Development Kit, 50+ pages of fixes, optimizations, tweaks, changes, AND ONE #LUDICROUS NEW WEAPON.

Coming SOON™ - AND ALL FOR FREE.

The Ludicrous Development Kit is coming to Rise of the Triad SOON™

And on Sunday (THIS SUNDAY), August 25th, (at 1pm PST/4pm EST /22:00 Interceptor Entertainment time) Frederik and Leon will take you through it LIVE in preparation for its release! 

If you are even remotely interested in level design and modding, you will want to be there! There will be prizes! It will be #LUDICROUS

Tune in at http://twitch.tv/interceptorentertainment!
